Very good coffee
Jan 2026 • Family
Vietnamese coffee is incredibly good and affordable, with a rich, bold flavor that coffee lovers truly appreciate. It’s known for its smooth yet strong taste, often sweetened with condensed milk in classics like cà phê sữa đá. What makes the experience even better is that it’s very cheap compared to many other places in the world, so you can enjoy high-quality coffee without spending much money. On top of that, the baristas in Vietnam are always friendly and welcoming, ready to make you feel at home. Whether in a small street shop or a cozy cafe, the warm service and delicious coffee leave you smiling and satisfied every time.

CƠM 1990 – A RESTAURANT TO CHERISH AUTHENTIC VIETNAMESE CUISINE
Aug 2024 • Business
My company had the opportunity to enjoy lunch at CƠM 1990 restaurant and was really impressed with the restaurant's excellent service. The ambiance in the restaurant was cozy and adorable and the old vibe decoration created a familiar and nostalgic feeling. Childhood memories came back to people born in the 90s like me.

High quality food with pure Vietnamese flavor was scrumptious beyond reproach, I was amazed by every dish. The price was quite reasonable (compared to other restaurants in the touristy area in the city centre). I truly like the way this restaurant does not use MSG and focuses on the freshness and purity of the ingredients to create dishes that were both DELICIOUS (NGON) and HEALTHY (LÀNH).

Especially, COM 1990 advocates environmentally friendly business by minimizing plastic waste and disposable items, I highly appreciate the efforts of the owners (Mr. Kevin & Ms. Binh) to protect the environment and develop sustainably. The staff there is professional and enthusiastic in supporting customers and the bosses are extremely hospitable, kind and dedicated to their passion.

In general, we were satisfied with the service and food quality at CƠM 1990, we would definitely come back for a long-term support and recommend it to more friends and relatives!

Quan Com 1990
Apr 2024 • Friends
Com 1990 is a great destination to enjoy those unique flavors. I enjoyed bun cha and Quang noodles here and was really impressed. Grilled vermicelli noodles are crispy and fragrant, combined with sweet and sour fish sauce, creating a delicious and irresistible dish. Quang noodles have a cool, rich taste, with ingredients such as shrimp, pork, raw vegetables, and rice paper making each piece of noodles more special. The prices here are also very reasonable, suitable for everyone's budget. The restaurant space is comfortable and clean, the staff is friendly and the service is quick. I will return to Quan Com 1990 every time I crave the traditional flavors of Central cuisine.
